evidence: Carries the Mining label and adds TxCollection to the node's mining interface and BlockAssembler for external block template validation.
rationale: Provides a dedicated interface for external mining coordinators like Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers to reconstruct and validate block templates without maintaining costly out-of-process mempool mirrors. It directly unblocks external mining tooling integration (sv2-apps #599) and expands the Mining interface.
